workflow_description: Handles the initialization of console tables from various data sources while enforcing structural constraints on columns and rows.
Calculates column widths and alignment policies based on data types and Unicode character properties to ensure correct visual layout.
Generates the final formatted string output in various styles and sends it to the target output stream, managing optional elements like row counts.
integration_test: [Fact] public void VerifyOutputRenderingAndFormattingWorkflow() { var users = new List<User> { new User { Name = "Alexandre", Age = 36 }, new User { Name = "René", Age = 59 } }; var stringWriter = new StringWriter(); var table = ConsoleTable.From(users); Assert.Equal(Console.Out, table.Options.OutputTo); table.Configure(o => { o.OutputTo = stringWriter; o.NumberAlignment = Alignment.Right; o.EnableCount = true; }); table.Write(Format.Default); string defaultOutput = stringWriter.ToString(); Assert.Contains("Alexandre", defaultOutput); Assert.Contains("Count: 2", defaultOutput); Assert.Contains(" 36 |", defaultOutput); stringWriter.GetStringBuilder().Clear(); table.Configure(o => o.EnableCount = false); table.Write(Format.Minimal); string minimalOutput = stringWriter.ToString(); Assert.Contains("René", minimalOutput); Assert.DoesNotContain("Count: 2", minimalOutput); stringWriter.GetStringBuilder().Clear(); table.Write(Format.MarkDown); string markdownOutput = stringWriter.ToString(); Assert.Contains("| Name | Age |", markdownOutput); Assert.Contains("|---|---", markdownOutput); stringWriter.GetStringBuilder().Clear(); table.Write(Format.Alternative); string alternativeOutput = stringWriter.ToString(); Assert.Contains("+---", alternativeOutput); Assert.Contains("| Alexandre", alternativeOutput); }
